title: rubus micans subsp. subrotundus
intro: Rubus micans subsp. subrotundus, commonly known as the rounded-leaf blackberry, is a plant species within the Rubus genus. It is known for its use in traditional medicine, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Rubus micans subsp. subrotundus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds like anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and salicylic acid, which may exhibit anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-viral activities. However, further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of this plant species and its bioactive constituents.
